title: The holiday table
say: Four pieces from McGee & Co. that set a table people remember. The shop's own photos and prices.
description: A holiday table in four pieces from McGee & Co.: Halloway mugs, Islington wine glasses, Laurel side plates and Pritchard dinner plates. Prices in dollars, photos from the shop.

items.name: Halloway Mugs, set of 4
items.alt: Four white stoneware mugs on a wooden table, set for breakfast.

items.name: Islington Wine Glasses, set of 4
items.alt: Four etched wine glasses on a set table.

items.name: Laurel Side Plates, set of 4
items.alt: A white side plate on a woven charger, on a dark table.

items.name: Pritchard Dinner Plates, set of 4
items.alt: A black-rimmed dinner plate on a ruffled linen placemat.
